rounds.title: Game Show Style
rounds.instructions: Varies weekly: True/False, Name That Tune, Multiple Choice, or Family Feud.

questions.clue: What ancient civilization is credited with the invention of the first known writing system called cuneiform?
questions.explanation: Cuneiform was developed by the Sumerians around 3200 BCE in Mesopotamia, making them the first to create a writing system.

questions.clue: Which famous artist was known for creating a series of paintings featuring the same subject during different times of day and seasons, notably in his work called 'The Haystacks'?
questions.explanation: Claude Monet created a series of 'Haystacks' paintings, exploring the effects of light and atmosphere on the same subject.

questions.clue: What is the name of the deep-sea trench located in the Pacific Ocean, known as the deepest part of the world's oceans?
questions.explanation: The Mariana Trench reaches a depth of about 36,000 feet, making it the deepest known part of the Earth's oceans.
